definitions.gloss: something (or someone) out of one's reach
definitions.explanation: Literally "a flower on a high peak": something one can admire but never have. Used for expensive things one cannot afford and, very often, for a person one is attracted to but thinks is far beyond one's reach.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{高嶺|たかね}の{花|はな}だ。
examples.english: She's way out of my league.

examples.japanese: ⟦こんな→こんな：02881_konna⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{僕|ぼく}→僕：01729_boku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{高嶺|たかね}の{花|はな}だ。
examples.english: An expensive car like this is beyond my reach.

examples.japanese: ⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ころ{高嶺|たかね}の{花|はな}だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}っていた→思う：00492_omou⟧⟦{先輩|せんぱい}→先輩：01451_senpai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧⟦{職場|しょくば}→職場：04164_shokuba⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}いている→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: I now work in the same office as the senior I thought was out of my reach back in school.

notes:
{高嶺|たかね} (a high peak) appears almost only in this phrase; it is also written {高根|たかね}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- 〜⟦にとって→にとって：06803_nitotte⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{高嶺|たかね}の{花|はな}だ: is beyond someone's reach
- {高嶺|たかね}の{花|はな}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{存在|そんざい}→存在：03326_sonzai⟧: someone admired from afar

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{届|とど}かない→届く：00899_todoku⟧: out of reach — the plain, literal way to say it
- ⟦{憧|あこが}れ→憧れ：12630_akogare⟧: longing, admiration — the feeling a {高嶺|たかね}の{花|はな} inspires
